steps.title: Start with the simple loop
steps.text: The shopper taps talk and asks for running shoes in size 42 under 120. A speech service returns the transcript, the model turns it into a filter patch, the catalog returns products in relevance order, and the browser speaks a short summary filled from them. A text box feeds the same loop without the voice. Product questions and the basket are out of scope.

steps.title: Draw the ownership line
steps.text: The browser owns the microphone, the phase, the filters, the results and the summary. Recognition streams to a speech service because browser recognition is uneven; the summary uses the browser speechSynthesis, which a branded server voice can replace later. The model and the catalog API each stay a black box behind its contract, and no product fact ever comes from the model.

steps.title: Keep one conversation store
steps.text: One store holds the phase (idle, listening, thinking or speaking) and the active turn with its AbortController. A tap of talk opens a turn, a status beside Talk says Starting until the microphone is live, and a second tap ends listening and releases the microphone. Cancel, shown from the tap through speaking, or Escape drops the turn; a text submit drops it and starts a text turn; talk during thinking or speaking cancels and listens again. Cancelling stops the spoken summary before the microphone opens and leaves the results; talking over the voice is not offered, since an open microphone would hear it.

steps.title: Turn words into a filter patch
steps.text: The model gets the transcript, the filters, the facet values and any pending choice, and returns a FilterPatch, a choice or out-of-scope. The store validates that JSON against the schema and the facets, using the rules in the Data section, and the patch commits only when its search lands. A follow-up such as in blue edits the current filters, shown as removable chips.

steps.title: Give every state a way out
steps.text: On a voice turn, a choice, an empty result or a problem met while thinking is spoken as a short templated line; problems met while listening are shown, not spoken. Every line also appears as text next to the text box, and the live region announces status once nothing is speaking.

blocks.title: Rejected alternative: let the model recommend in its own words
blocks.text: A model suggesting products from memory names items, prices and stock the store may not have. Here every line the shopper hears or reads is a template filled from catalog records, facet values or the transcript.
